Infinite Spaces builds the PlayBox, where creators author living worlds that an audience helps shape, and
pilot new forms of play and social entertainment into any place: a venue, a live stream, a home. 
Underneath is a mesh network people join from any device, so a world can be authored and run by many people at once from anywhere.

The tools for these kinds of game mechanics don't exist yet. You'll be working on agentic authoring and orchestration, 
frontier world models, 3D gaussian splats and radiance fields, in real-time volumetric streaming environments. 

You'll build and lead a world class engineering team to tackle this frontier. 
You'll bring a game design and production background, and you'll own how
we design, build, ship, and monetize these experiences. Under the hood, we're a Rust shop. Our services run
in containers under a control plane, and AI agents are part of how we build.

## What You'll Do

- Lead and grow the engineering team
- Set the technical direction for game mechanics built on volumetric authoring, environments and streaming
- Work hands-on with frontier world models, 3D gaussian splats and radiance fields, and real-time spatial systems
- Bring game design methodology to how we prototype, playtest, and iterate on experiences
- Build the production infrastructure that supports game experiences and monetization
- Work with the founders on what we build and in what order

## What We're Looking For

- A background in game design and production development, with games you helped ship
- Game industry experience across the entire lifecycle from concept to revenue and growth
- Proven experience leading an engineering team
- Deep experience in Unreal, Unity, or web game development
- Fluency in Blender and generative 3d tools
- A working command of game design methodology 
- Experience building production infrastructure for game experiences and monetization

#### Nice to Have

- Exposure to immersive or virtual production environments backed by real-time systems 
- Hands-on work with gaussian splats, radiance fields, or volumetric capture
- Experience with world models or generative 3D
- Streaming or networked real-time games infrastructure that scales
